title: ext4 directory entries should be skipped to the next entry by rec_len
summary: The name_len of a directory entry only counts name bytes, and rec_len describes the range occupied by the record, which may include alignment and remaining space.
applies: ext4 file system image; Linux kernel format document
detail: Even if the current name is short, the next item may not immediately follow the end of the name; during parsing, the record range is checked within the corresponding directory block.
boundary: Indexed directories, check tails, and other directory features introduce additional structure, and each segment of remaining space cannot be interpreted as a normal file name.
relevance: Check the true starting point of the next file name in the original directory block.
